language.title: Language
language.intro: Choose the language for the app. Money, dates and emergency numbers stay the same.
language.saveFailed: Saved on this phone. We could not save it to your account yet, so messages from Poolora may stay in the old language for now.

sos.title: Safety and SOS
sos.callIfDanger: Call {{number}} if you are in danger.
sos.smsBody: SOS. I need help during a Poolora ride.
sos.threatNotSent: {{message}} The safety team still has your alert.
sos.micBody: Allow Poolora to use the microphone in your phone settings to record during an SOS.
sos.safeConfirmTitle: Tell the safety team you are safe?
sos.safeConfirmBody: They will still call you to check, then close the alert. Your emergency contacts will be told you are safe.
sos.locationAllow: Allow location access to share where you are.

active.title: SOS alert active
active.sub: The Poolora safety team has been alerted and can see where you are.
active.retryingSub: No connection yet. We keep trying every few seconds. Call {{number}}, or text your contacts from your phone.
active.closedCancelled: You cancelled the alert. Your contacts were not told.
active.closedByTeam: The safety team has closed your alert.
active.safeSub: You said you are safe. The safety team will call you to check, then close the alert.
active.acknowledgedSub: The safety team has your alert and will call you. Keep your phone with you.

sos.textingIn: Texting your emergency contacts in {{seconds}} s
sos.cancelAccident: Cancel, I pressed it by accident
sos.sentTo: Text with your live location sent to:
sos.noContactsToText: You have no emergency contacts to text. Add some after this so they can be told next time.
sos.textFailed: We could not text your emergency contacts. Call them, or text them from your phone.
sos.lowBattery: Battery {{percent}}%. If your phone dies, the safety team keeps your last position and can still see the other phones on the ride.
sos.textFromPhone: Text my contacts from my phone
sos.textFromPhoneHint: Opens your messaging app with a message and your location; works without data
sos.leaveScreen: Leave this screen (the alert stays on)
sos.holdLabel: SOS. Press and hold for 3 seconds to alert the safety team
sos.holdHint: Your emergency contacts are texted 10 seconds later unless you cancel
sos.needsRide: SOS alerts work during a confirmed ride. If you are in danger now, call {{number}}.
sos.holdInstructions: Hold for 3 seconds. The safety team is alerted at once; your emergency contacts 10 seconds later, unless you cancel.
sos.fakeCallHint: Your phone rings in a few seconds, so you have a reason to leave
sos.audioBody: Off unless you switch it on. During an SOS your phone records what it hears and sends it to the Poolora safety team only, in parts of a minute.
sos.contactsEmpty: Add people who should get a text with your location if you raise an SOS.
